lines.text: God tells Moses to make a gold-covered altar of acacia wood for burning incense, placed in front of the veil.
Aaron is to burn incense on the altar every morning and at twilight, and atone on its horns yearly.
Each counted man twenty or older pays a half shekel as a ransom so that no famine will come.
Aaron and his sons must wash their hands and feet at the bronze basin so that they will not die.
Moses is to anoint Aaron and his sons to serve God as judges, and no one may copy the oil.
